summary: Make the dedicated Owner gateway's procd startup recreate its volatile /var log directory and restore private mode 0700 before Nginx validation; reject package builds that omit the boot guard and run a host regression test in CI.

evidence.primary_source: OpenWrt documents /var as a symlink into volatile /tmp storage and documents procd init scripts as the service startup mechanism: https://openwrt.org/docs/techref/filesystems and https://openwrt.org/docs/guide-developer/procd-init-scripts.
validation: python3 tests/opal_owner_local_control_boot_test.py: PASS (7 cases: recreate after volatile-directory loss, repair mode, reject symlink, stop on mkdir/chmod/Nginx failure, and verify package guard).
All nine repository-mandated HBNF lifecycle/release regression commands: PASS; the live-sweep runner suite used its own mocked device calls and did not contact hardware.
No router restart, live service mutation, firmware change, or UV output change is part of this source-only change.
evidence.rollback: Revert the source commit; no live device state was changed.
